behavior_under_test: A creator can go from a deterministic public template to an installable data-only package without manually editing the CM2 Runtime catalog.
negative_cases: unsafe clean outside project SDK root

regression.compatibility_matrix: pass; revalidated by Step 9.5 public resolver and policy hash

reload.identity: After returning to the main menu and reopening Mod Manager, _AI Test Consumer SDK Alpha appeared in Local Files and its exact name/path was selected before Play.
reload.screen_saver_recovery: The initial input desktop was Screen-saver, so focus and BitBlt were correctly refused. Emergency release ran; one virtual-HID Space wake changed the input desktop to Default and restored the exact Teardown foreground handle before any menu action.

live_run.assertion: The independent live Mod displayed CREATOR SDK CLI ALPHA CONSUMER PASS, cm2.creator.hello-ship@0.1.0, accepted Ship, rejected ExecuteLua, shared Compiler hash, exact package hash, and Runtime Lua forbidden/not loaded.

attributed_external_noise.details: The load-window lines explicitly identify the external TABS path (two missing sound banks and deprecated pre-init API use). No line identifies the SDK project or Consumer. A fresh post-load cursor had zero additional errors/warnings.

defect_loop.failure: The prior CLI ignored ProjectPath and silently validated/built the repository PackageManifest fixture; its new command generated a template its own validate/build commands could not consume.
defect_loop.fix: Made package.source.json under ProjectPath authoritative, generated a fully buildable five-definition Hello Ship, hydrated source hashes and removed hidden fallback use for project commands.
defect_loop.regression: Two independently initialized roots validate and build byte-identical package, Compiler and report artifacts.

defect_loop.failure: The prior validate command rewrote the formal PackageManifest artifact because it omitted ArtifactPath, and build copied metadata without executing the shared Compiler.
defect_loop.fix: All validation now uses isolated report/artifact paths; validate/build/test/package run the shared Compiler and preserve its structured first diagnostic.
defect_loop.regression: Compiler invalid-range input fails with exact definitionId/runtime.priority/suggestion and preserves last-valid output.

defect_loop.failure: The prior documentation claimed Teardown was unavailable and had no independent SDK-produced Consumer start evidence.
defect_loop.fix: Added an independent disposable SDK Consumer, exact build installer and runtime identity surface; reopened Mod Manager and started it in the installed Teardown 2.0.4 process.
defect_loop.regression: Live PASS surface, exact hashes, valid/invalid operations, clean post-load log delta and emergency release are recorded.

scope_boundary: Step 9.2 proves the public CLI/template/compiler/package and independent data-only Consumer boundary. It does not claim that CM2 instantiates the generated ship/weapon as gameplay Runtime; install/remove plus S0/S8 gameplay conformance remains Step 9.3.
